name: no-alias-export
description: An export that is only another name for an existing symbol — two names for one concept, and the compiler can never tell you when one dies
fixHint: Pick one name and update its callers. `tsc` cannot see a dead export (it assumes an external consumer), so an alias whose callers all moved to the real name stays forever. Derived values like `X.length` are not aliases and do not match this rule.
